info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Careers Applications Submit-v5-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Submission API allows organizations to streamline the process of submitting job applications. By leveraging this API, recruitment teams can efficiently receive and process applications from job seekers. This endpoint is designed for HR managers and recruiting platforms who need to integrate application submissions into their workflow. It supports submission of various application data, ensuring a smooth experience for applicants and enabling faster hiring decisions.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a new application for processing. It handles the required validation and response generation to provide immediate feedback on the submission status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new application. It should contain all necessary details required for processing the application.

204.description: The request was successful, and there is no content to return.
